revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, looking across a large indoor public area with varied furniture, open sightlines, realistic foot-traffic cues, industrial vinyl flooring, and moderate backlight balanced by usable foreground fill. Moderate side view at closer inspection distance with natural perspective and realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A young adult woman with an athletic build is clearly visible, wearing a pale sweater and black trousers, with black and teal clothing elements. She is kneeling beside a low object and reaching forward, with knee and shin support visible and torso not lying down. Practical clutter is kept behind the subject, no foreground obstruction. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, not cinematic or advertising. No text, captions, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
